system.description: After incantations and gestures, the ritualist causes a mortal target (willing or unwilling) to exhibit no signs of life — no pulse, no breath, and even mechanical monitors will register death, though actual injuries are unaffected. Blood from wounds merely trickles and congeals rather than flowing. The effect lasts until the sunrise after the night it is cast and has no effect on supernatural beings. To empower the ritual, the caster must place a small dead insect or animal somewhere in the subject's actual home (not a hotel or borrowed residence — it will not work on the homeless), requiring a fresh insect for each casting.
